extra_vocab.en: to learn about something so that you know it well
extra_vocab.note: 在這篇通知裡，familiarize themselves with the user documentation 是客氣但明確的要求：送出第一份申請前，請先讀過使用說明。語氣正式，常見於公司公告。
extra_vocab.grammar_note: 常用 familiarize + oneself／某人 + with + 事物；with 不能省，不說 familiarize the system。

example.en: The handbook familiarizes new hires with the company's expense procedures.
example.zh: 這本手冊讓新進員工熟悉公司的報帳程序。

example.en: Most staff familiarized themselves with the system during the trial week.
example.zh: 大多數員工在試用週期間就熟悉了這個系統。

example.en: We are familiarizing the sales team with the updated pricing tool.
example.zh: 我們正在讓業務團隊熟悉更新後的報價工具。

example.en: Please familiarize yourself with the safety rules before your first shift.
example.zh: 第一次上班前，請先熟悉安全規定。

example.en: The tour will familiarize new employees with the layout of the office.
example.zh: 這次導覽會讓新員工熟悉辦公室的配置。

example.en: We held a workshop to familiarize staff with the new software.
example.zh: 我們舉辦了工作坊，讓員工熟悉新軟體。

examples.en: Managers should familiarize themselves with the updated travel policy.
examples.zh: 主管應該先熟悉更新後的差旅政策。

examples.en: The first session will familiarize trainees with our main products.
examples.zh: 第一堂課會讓受訓者熟悉我們的主要產品。

confusable.diff: memorize 是「背下來」；familiarize 是「讓…熟悉、了解」，不需要背誦。

example.en: You do not need to memorize the manual; just keep it nearby.
example.zh: 你不需要背下手冊，只要放在手邊就好。

similar.diff: get to know 較口語，可用於人或事物；familiarize 較正式，常用於公告與說明。

example.en: It takes a few weeks to get to know the new system.
example.zh: 要花幾個星期才能熟悉這個新系統。

similar.diff: become acquainted with 更正式、更書面，常用於初次接觸某人或某事。

example.en: New staff will become acquainted with each department during orientation.
example.zh: 新員工會在新人訓練中認識各個部門。

example.en: Orientation for new employees starts at nine on Monday.
example.zh: 新進員工的訓練在週一九點開始。

example.en: Please follow the guidelines when you fill out the form.
example.zh: 填寫表格時請遵照指引。

example.en: The manual explains how to install the printer.
example.zh: 這本手冊說明如何安裝印表機。

derived.link: familiar 是詞幹；familiar + -ize，「使變得…」，像 modern → modernize、organize

extra_vocab.en: giving details that show what something is like
extra_vocab.note: 在這篇通知裡，be descriptive about the item you need 是請員工填申請時把所需物品寫清楚（規格、數量等），因為含糊的內容會拖慢核准。
extra_vocab.grammar_note: 「對…描述得詳細」用 be descriptive about + N；形容詞，不加 -ly 當副詞用（副詞是 descriptively）。

example.en: A more descriptive product name would help buyers find the item.
example.zh: 更具說明性的產品名稱能幫助買家找到這個品項。

example.en: Her report was the most descriptive of all the submissions we received.
example.zh: 她的報告是我們收到的所有提交資料中描述最詳細的。

example.en: Please be descriptive about the problem when you contact support.
example.zh: 聯絡客服時，請詳細描述問題。

example.en: Give each file a descriptive title so it is easy to find.
example.zh: 每個檔案都請取一個能說明內容的標題，方便尋找。

example.en: The brochure uses descriptive language to attract new visitors.
example.zh: 這本手冊用描述性的文字吸引新的訪客。

examples.en: A more descriptive subject line would help readers open the message.
examples.zh: 更具說明性的主旨會讓讀者更願意打開信件。

examples.en: The order form asks for a descriptive name for each item.
examples.zh: 訂購單要求每個品項都寫上說明清楚的名稱。

confusable.diff: destructive 是「破壞性的」，拼法和 descriptive 很像，但意思完全不同。

example.en: The storm was highly destructive to the coastal warehouses.
example.zh: 這場風暴對沿海的倉庫造成嚴重破壞。

similar.diff: detailed 強調資訊「很詳細」；descriptive 強調用文字把事物「描述出來」。

example.en: Please send a detailed report on the delay.
example.zh: 請寄一份關於延誤的詳細報告。

similar.diff: specific 強調「明確、具體」，不含糊；descriptive 強調描述得豐富。

example.en: Be specific about the date and time you need.
example.zh: 請明確寫出你需要的日期與時間。

example.en: Please include every detail of the request.
example.zh: 請在申請中寫入所有細節。

example.en: An accurate description will speed up the approval.
example.zh: 準確的描述會加快核准速度。

example.en: His answer was too vague to be useful.
example.zh: 他的回答太含糊，派不上用場。

derived.link: describe 是詞幹，「把…寫出來、說出來」
describe 的 -be 變成 -ption，像 subscribe → subscription
descriptive + -ly，形容詞加 -ly 變副詞，像 quickly

extra_vocab.en: a phone number people can call to get help or information quickly
extra_vocab.note: 在這篇通知裡，the IT hotline 是資訊部門提供的專線，遇到系統問題的員工可在平日 8 點到 18 點撥打。

example.en: The bank runs separate hotlines for billing questions and lost cards.
example.zh: 銀行為帳單問題和卡片遺失分別設有專線。

example.en: If the system freezes, call the hotline for immediate help.
example.zh: 如果系統當掉，請撥打專線尋求立即協助。

example.en: The customer service hotline is open until nine at night.
example.zh: 客服專線開放到晚上九點。

example.en: The hotline number is printed on the back of the card.
example.zh: 專線號碼印在卡片背面。

example.en: We set up a 24-hour hotline for emergency repairs.
example.zh: 我們設立了二十四小時專線處理緊急維修。

examples.en: Staff can report any problem to the hotline on weekdays.
examples.zh: 員工平日可向專線回報任何問題。

examples.en: The hotline received over two hundred calls on the first day.
examples.zh: 專線在第一天就接到超過兩百通電話。

confusable.diff: headline 是「新聞標題」，字尾也是 -line，但和電話專線無關。

example.en: The company's new product made the headline of the business section.
example.zh: 公司的新產品登上了財經版的頭條。

similar.diff: helpline 強調提供協助與諮詢；hotline 強調能快速直接聯絡，常用於緊急或專門服務。

example.en: Our helpline answers questions about the new payment process.
example.zh: 我們的服務專線回答有關新付款流程的問題。

similar.diff: help desk 通常是公司內部的支援窗口（也可以是櫃台）；hotline 指專門的電話號碼。

example.en: Please contact the help desk if you forget your password.
example.zh: 如果忘記密碼，請聯絡支援窗口。

example.en: Technical support is available from eight to six.
example.zh: 技術支援的服務時間是八點到六點。

example.en: We answer every inquiry within one business day.
example.zh: 我們會在一個工作天內回覆每一則詢問。

example.en: The operator will connect you to the right department.
example.zh: 接線員會幫您轉接到正確的部門。

example.en: Please dial extension 305 to reach the IT team.
example.zh: 請撥分機 305 找資訊團隊。
